translations.web: Because they don’t respect the works of Yahweh, nor the operation of his hands, he will break them down and not build them up.
translations.bsb: Since they show no regard for the works of the LORD or what His hands have done, He will tear them down and never rebuild them.
translations.kjv: Because they regard not the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.
translations.asv: Because they regard not the works of Jehovah, Nor the operation of his hands, He will break them down and not build them up.
